items.event: Alfred Dunhill Links Championship (DP World Tour)
items.line: Casey Jarvis, already a two-time winner on the DP World Tour this year, led by one at 11-under after round 2, with MJ Daffue and Matthew Jordan one back. Weekend play continues across St Andrews, Carnoustie and Kingsbarns. Tee times not confirmed.
items.whenJst: Sat Oct 03 – Sun Oct 04 · rounds 3-4 (tee times TBC) JST

items.line: Runs Oct 7-18 in Shanghai, with Sinner, Zverev and Alcaraz among the top seeds and Vacherot defending champion. Finals Sunday Oct 18; start time not confirmed.
